packageRules.description: Poetry locks the newest in-range release, not the one Renovate targeted, so Renovate rejects the lockfile an in-range update writes. :pinDevDependencies misses these groups because a Poetry group's depType is its name
Rebase every Renovate branch once master moves, so a pull request held for review picks up master's fixes

customManagers.description: Read `# renovate:` annotations above *_VERSION pins in dev container setup scripts
